changelog:
• Dynamic Wi-Fi TV & Cast Receiver Discovery: Removed hardcoded home fleet fallbacks. Cast service now dynamically scans local physical Wi-Fi interfaces (bypassing VPN/Tailscale tunnels) via mDNS (Google Cast) and SSDP (Roku, DLNA, Kodi).
• Connect to TV by IP Address: Added manual IP entry in the Cast sheet to directly probe and cast to Chromecast, Android TV, Google TV, or Roku on AP-isolated hotel/guest networks.
